name: trackdub-api
description: api.trackdub.com — Cloudflare Worker backend (Better Auth + D1 + Drizzle) for the Trackdub portal.

scripts.dev:activation:local: wrangler dev --config wrangler.activation.jsonc --local --port 8787 --var APP_ENV:development --var ACTIVATION_ISSUER:trackdub://dev-activation --var ACTIVATION_AUDIENCE:trackdub-license-dev --var SIGNING_KEY_ID:dev-2026-07 --var ALLOW_DEV_LICENSES:true
scripts.db:migrate:activation:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply trackdub_activation --local --config wrangler.activation.jsonc
scripts.db:seed:activation:dev-license: wrangler d1 execute trackdub_activation --local --config wrangler.activation.jsonc --command "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO licenses (id, key_hash, tier, buyer_email, status, max_machines) VALUES ('00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000dev01', '9a9409fd533db04c6c52af636bf999ff88a03f0d1e0a549244093c90ef0ca49e', 'pro', 'dev@local', 'active', 1)"
scripts.db:migrate:activation:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply trackdub_activation --remote --config wrangler.activation.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:activation:staging:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply trackdub_activation_staging --remote --config wrangler.activation.staging.jsonc
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:activation
